comment: * An interface used for Notification views to delegate handling the loading of icons.

methods.name: Runnable updateIcon(@NonNull NotificationDrawableConsumer drawableConsumer, @Nullable Icon icon)
methods.comment:
* Called when a new icon is provided to display.
     *
     * @param drawableConsumer a consumer, which can display the loaded drawable.
     * @param icon             the updated icon to be displayed.
     *
     * @return a {@link Runnable} that sets the drawable on the consumer

methodNames: Runnable updateIcon(@NonNull NotificationDrawableConsumer drawableConsumer, @Nullable Icon icon)
